Browser.d: Keeps copies for one user. The fastest layer, but nobody else benefits from it.
Browser.x: Asked as: which layer serves a repeat visit by the same user?

CDN edge.d: A cache close to many users. A miss goes on to the origin server.

Origin.d: Holds the real data. Every cache layer exists to avoid asking it.

Write-through.d: Every write goes to the cache and the store at once: safe, slower writes.

Write-back.d: Writes land in the cache and reach the store later: fast, can lose data on a crash.
